opening: I am applying for the Product Manager - AI Agent Studio position because Hypatos is building AI agents for document-heavy enterprise workflows, an area closely connected to my work in automation, data parsing and product delivery.
core: Over the past three years I have turned business requirements into production features across several European technology projects.
At UltraStrategy I built an AI-based CV parsing workflow using n8n and Eden AI, and at Clubee I worked on API integration and QA.
At FlowSpace I built AI support agents, GTM automations and data-parsing tools while helping grow the platform from 2,000 to more than 4,500 users.
I use Claude Code alongside TypeScript, Next.js, Laravel and Supabase, and verify generated changes before shipping them.
I am based in Venice, hold an EU long-term residence permit and am available immediately.
role_specific: My background is adjacent to a formal Product Manager title, but the work has required product ownership across customer needs, workflow design, implementation and go-to-market execution. I have integrated OpenAI, Anthropic, OfficeRnD and Nexudus APIs and contributed to FlowSpace's migration from Bubble to Next.js and Laravel.
closing: I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my hands-on product-building and automation experience could contribute to Hypatos and the AI Agent Studio.
